notes: The article on הַמִּדְיָנִית is unrepresented because the ASV renders the phrase indefinitely, *a Midianitish woman*, and the indefinite article joins the nominal under rule 15.
*while* is the connective the ASV wrote for the circumstantial waw, so it is neither added nor a supplied subordinator (rules 14, 55).
פֶּתַח אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד carries no preposition, so the supplied *at* is licensed by the adverbial accusative itself (rule 33).
